scripts.test: cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/steps/**/*.ts --format json:reports/report.json tests/features/**/*.feature && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:with-report: npm run test && npm run report
scripts.run:all: npm run clean-reports && npm run test && npm run report
scripts.clean-reports: rimraf reports && mkdir reports && mkdir reports/html
scripts.test:AIRunner: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/steps/**/*.ts --require tests/support/**/*.ts --tags "@AIRunner" --format json:reports/report.json tests/features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:MenuRunner: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/steps/**/*.ts --require tests/support/**/*.ts --tags "@MenuRunner" --format json:reports/report.json tests/features/**/*.feature
scripts.test:drop1: npx cucumber-js --require-module ts-node/register --require tests/steps/**/*.ts --require tests/support/**/*.ts --tags "@drop1" --format json:reports/report.json tests/features/**/*.feature
